quizName:
Hardest Questions in North carolina
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This warns other drivers.

questions.question: Before starting the car, you should:

options.text: Be sure only backseat passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Be sure only adult passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Be sure only child passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Be sure all passengers have buckled their seat belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be sure all passengers have buckled their seat belts.
questions.explanation: Make it a habit to buckle your seat belt and check that all passengers do the same before you start driving.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on a freeway, you should:

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your lane.
Continue to the next exit or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to the next exit or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: Never back up on a freeway or shoulder. Go to the next exit or safe location to turn around.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop and move your car off the road if possible. Check for injuries and call 911 if needed. Report the crash to police if there is an injury, death, or property damage over $1,000.

questions.question: When driving on major highways, you should:

options.text: Be ready to react to hazards.

questions.explanation: Stay alert on highways and scan the road constantly. Do not stare at one spot for more than a few seconds. This helps you avoid "highway hypnosis" and react to danger.

questions.question: If you miss your freeway exit, you should:

options.text: Make a U-turn through the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back up.

questions.explanation: Go to the next exit. Do not stop, back up, or cross the median on a freeway. These actions are illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: Before driving while taking non-prescription drugs, you should:

options.text: Read the label to check for warnings.
Drive no matter what the label says.

questions.correctAnswerText: Read the label to check for warnings.
questions.explanation: Many over-the-counter medicines can affect your driving. Check the label for warnings. If unsure, ask your doctor or pharmacist before driving.

questions.question: When you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and create distance between yourself and the aggressive driver. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or rude gestures.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign means you must stop and let others go first if they have the right-of-way. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. What should you do?

options.text: Not worry about it because all vehicles are the same.
Hide from your friend that you don't know the vehicle well.
Ignore any obvious problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Spend a few minutes learning where everything is and how it works before you drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spend a few minutes learning where everything is and how it works before you drive.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, take time to locate and learn how to use the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road will cross ahead.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if you don't see any other cars.
Signal only if there are other cars nearby.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if you don't see any other cars.
questions.explanation: Always signal when you turn, change lanes, or pull away from the curb. Make this a habit and follow this rule every time.

questions.question: When you see railroad tracks ahead, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Don't worry about how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop. A train or other rail vehicle may be coming.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make many decisions while driving. Any activity that takes attention away from driving is dangerous and puts you and others at risk.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must do. It means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: You are angry after something that happened at work. When you get in your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly to stop thinking about it.
Drive fast on the highway to release your anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive home.
Stop at a bar for a drink before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive home.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait until you feel calm before you drive. Driving while angry is dangerous to you and everyone on the road.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: You must have your license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance in your car when you drive. You must show all three if stopped.

questions.question: Who must wear a seat belt in a moving vehicle?
questions.explanation: In North Carolina, the driver and all passengers must wear seat belts when the vehicle is moving. This applies to all occupants, even in vehicles with airbags.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter this road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and use a different route.

questions.question: Driving ability can be impaired by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires being in good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and drowsiness all impair your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?

options.text: It makes you feel overly confident

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects brain control of judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, coordination, and balance. It also impairs your vision and ability to judge distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on an interstate:

options.text: Get off at the next exit and return to the exit you missed
Ask the driver next to you for help

questions.correctAnswerText: Get off at the next exit and return to the exit you missed
questions.explanation: Do not back up or turn around on the highway if you miss your exit. Go to the next exit and safely turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that drivers must obey. When this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You should slow down:

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, where there are pedestrians, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: Night driving is more difficult than day driving because:

options.text: Cars overheat more quickly at night
You cannot see as well in the dark
It is more likely to rain at night
You are more likely to encounter a motorcycle

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as well in the dark
questions.explanation: At night, your vision is limited. Use headlights and drive slowly enough to stop within the distance you can see ahead.

questions.question: If someone is driving aggressively behind you, what should you do?

options.text: Stare at the driver as they pass.
Speed up while they are passing.

questions.explanation: When an aggressive driver is behind you, move out of their way. Do not make eye contact with them. Do not speed up or block them, as this will make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: When must you stop your vehicle?

options.text: When a traffic officer tells you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop at stop signs, red lights, and whenever a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.question: What does alcohol do to your driving?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: What should you do when a school bus stops with its stop arm extended?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait.
Honk your horn before passing on the left.
Keep driving once children have exited.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has its stop arm out, you must come to a complete stop. Do not move until the stop arm goes down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabled parking permits only.
